compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Add LLM fallback routing for missing-engine recipe tasks in sprint Phase E
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase E dispatch to detect recipe: tasks whose engines appear in MISSING_ENGINES_LIST (from S4 pre-flight) and convert them to LLM sub-agent tasks using translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh.

## Why
Instruction-file update: sprint orchestrator needs explicit guidance for recipe task fallback — when an engine is unavailable, dispatch the equivalent LLM task instead and record the degradation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Phase E recipe: task handling section gains a fallback branch: 'if recipe's engine appears in MISSING_ENGINES_LIST from check-recipe-engines.sh output, then:'
  1. Call bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/sprint/translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh --recipe=<name> --intent=<capability_description> [--param key=value ...] --output-format=task-prompt to produce LLM task description
  2. Dispatch a normal LLM sub-agent with the translated task description (same dispatch flow as GREEN tasks)
  3. Record a ticket comment on the recipe task: 'RECIPE_FALLBACK: recipe=<name> engine=<engine_name> reason=engine_not_installed — executing via LLM sub-agent'
  4. Fallback LLM task proceeds through normal Phase F (review, commit, verify) — identical downstream structure
- When MISSING_ENGINES_LIST is empty or recipe engine is present: use normal recipe execution path (no change to existing behavior)
- Fallback dispatch counts toward max_agents cap (usage-aware)
- Existing tests remain still-valid (SKILL.md is instruction-only)

## File Impact
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — instruction-file change; tests still-valid

## Dependencies
- 0f68-f9fd (translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh must exist before SKILL.md references it)
